Hi Liam — thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Quick answers up front, then a proposed plan: 

- Drawdown cadence: For GCP private offers the commit is typically recorded as a Marketplace purchase and drawdown happens on the GCP invoice when usage is reconciled. Practically most customers prefer a monthly drawdown so it maps to monthly invoices; quarterly is possible but makes forecasting harder.
- Billing visibility: Charges will show up on your GCP invoice under the Marketplace partner line item. Redwood can also provide monthly cost reports and a consolidated invoice stub on request.
- Co-sell credits: The Marketplace co-sell program (if eligible) issues credits via GCP to your billing account — we will need the partner-sales rep to confirm eligibility and timing.
- Tax/withholding: That depends on country-of-invoice. If Finch Express pays from the UK entity we should confirm VAT implications; finance will need the final billing entity on the PO.

Proposed next steps:
1) GCP rep confirms whether this private offer is co-sell eligible and whether credits apply to the proposed commit.
2) We agree on monthly drawdown starting May 1, 2026 (unless procurement asks for different).
3) We exchange final billing entity and sign via DocuSign (I can prepare the signature packet).

I'm attaching a short summary of how Redwood handles Marketplace private offers (redwood_gcp_private_offer_summary.pdf). Can you confirm the billing entity and if you want monthly vs quarterly?

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Confirmed from Marketplace side:
- This private offer (offer id: abcd-privatelink) is eligible for co-sell. Any credits will be applied as reductions on the GCP invoice line item for the Marketplace purchase.
- Drawdown: GCP processes usage reconciliation monthly; the private-offer commitment is reconciled at invoice time. For a $500k annual commit, we recommend a monthly drawdown (approx $41,666/month) so your finance team has consistent monthly spend on the invoice.
- Invoicing flow: GCP issues the invoice to the billing account you configure. The partner (Redwood) will also receive the marketplace settlement; Redwood's partner billing records can be used for your GL reconciliation.

- Billing account ID to attach to the offer
- Billing entity for tax purposes (US or UK)
